newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian housing groups welcome figures.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian housing groups welcome figures.

text.p: Australian housing groups welcomed on Tuesday data showing a strong improvement in the level of housing finance in July.
Finance commitments for owner-occupied housing in Australia rose 16.0 percent by volume to 40,483 dwellings in July, seasonally adjusted, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.

Housing Industry Association Ltd national executive director Ron Silberberg said the housing sector was poised to move into a recovery phase. "This is the clear message to emerge from the July housing finance approval figures released today," Silberberg said in a statement.
Master Builders Australia national director economics and housing Wilhelm Harnisch said the rise was an "extremely welcome sign" to the industry after a prolonged period of decline.

He said another welcome sign was the 10.6 percent increase in the number of loans for new houses, which indicated that some of the excess housing stock was starting to be absorbed. This should result in a future increase in new housing activity. The strong rise in commitments ... is welcome, indicating a return of confidence in the housing market and an important pointer for the direction of future new housing activity," he said in a statement. -- Canberra Bureau 61-6 273 2730
